reg_deadline.en: Online and by mail: closed 15 days before Election Day, on October 19, 2026. In person: register at your city or township clerk's office through 8 p.m. on Election Day, and bring proof of residency.
reg_deadline.es: En línea y por correo: cerró 15 días antes del Día de las Elecciones, el 19 de octubre de 2026. En persona: regístrate en la oficina del secretario de tu ciudad o municipio (clerk) hasta las 8 p. m. del Día de las Elecciones, y lleva un comprobante de domicilio.
reg_deadline.quote: Within 14 days of an election , and on Election Day, voters may only register by visiting their local clerk’s office or satellite office to register in person with proof of residency documentation.

mail_request.en: Online or by mail: your local clerk must receive your application by 5 p.m. on Friday, October 30, 2026. In person at your clerk's office: by 4 p.m. on Monday, November 2.
mail_request.es: En línea o por correo: el secretario local (clerk) debe recibir tu solicitud a más tardar a las 5 p. m. del viernes 30 de octubre de 2026. En persona en la oficina del secretario: a más tardar a las 4 p. m. del lunes 2 de noviembre.
mail_request.quote: Mailed applications must be received by a voter’s local city or township clerk’s office by 5 p.m. the Friday before Election Day.
mail_request.en_after: Online and mail applications closed at 5 p.m. on October 30. If you're registered at your current address, you can still get an absentee ballot at your clerk's office until 4 p.m. on Monday, November 2. On Election Day, only people registering or updating their address at the clerk's office, or voters with a sudden emergency, can get one.
mail_request.es_after: Las solicitudes en línea y por correo cerraron a las 5 p. m. del 30 de octubre. Si estás registrado en tu dirección actual, todavía puedes pedir una boleta de voto en ausencia en la oficina de tu secretario (clerk) hasta las 4 p. m. del lunes 2 de noviembre. El Día de las Elecciones, solo pueden pedirla quienes se registran o actualizan su dirección en la oficina del secretario, o quienes tienen una emergencia repentina.
mail_request.notes: Election Day limits from the SOS Vote on Election Day page, read Oct 28: 'if the voter is already registered to vote at their current address, they are not eligible to request an absentee ballot on Election Day. In emergency situations only, a voter may apply for an absentee ballot from their local clerk's office as late as 4 p.m. on Election Day.' Emergency rule: MCL 168.759b (sudden illness, disability or a death in the family; ballot back to the clerk by 8 p.m.).

mail_return.en: Your local clerk must receive it by 8 p.m. on Tuesday, November 3, 2026. A postmark isn't enough, so this close to Election Day use a drop box or your clerk's office instead of the mail. Military and overseas ballots count if they're postmarked by Election Day and arrive within 6 days after.
mail_return.es: Tu secretario local (clerk) debe recibirla a más tardar a las 8 p. m. del martes 3 de noviembre de 2026. El matasellos no basta, así que a estas alturas usa un buzón de entrega o la oficina de tu secretario en vez del correo. Las boletas de militares y de votantes en el extranjero cuentan si tienen matasellos a más tardar del Día de las Elecciones y llegan dentro de los 6 días siguientes.
mail_return.quote: Absentee ballots must be received by a voter's local clerk's office by 8 p.m. on Election Day to be counted, with the exception of military and overseas ballots which must be postmarked on or before Election Day and received by their local clerk within 6 days after the election in order to be counted.

early_hours.en: Every early voting site is open at least 8 hours a day for the nine days. Your community sets the exact hours, and some add days.
early_hours.es: Cada centro de votación anticipada abre por lo menos 8 horas al día durante los nueve días. Tu comunidad fija el horario exacto, y algunas agregan días.
early_hours.quote: Is open for at least 8 hours each day during the required 9 consecutive days of early voting.

cure.en: Missing or mismatched signature on your absentee ballot envelope? Return the cure form by 5 p.m. on Friday, November 6, 2026.
cure.es: ¿Falta la firma en el sobre de tu boleta de voto en ausencia o no coincide? Devuelve el formulario para corregirla (cure form) a más tardar a las 5 p. m. del viernes 6 de noviembre de 2026.
cure.quote: An absent voter ballot return envelope that is not cured by 5 p.m. on the third day following the election remains rejected.

in_person.en: Vote early at your assigned early voting site, or one of several if your community has more. Every community offers early voting October 24 to November 1. Some add days, and starting in 2026 that can include Monday, November 2, so check your site. You put your ballot straight into the tabulator, like on Election Day. On Election Day, go to your assigned polling place between 7 a.m. and 8 p.m.
in_person.es: Vota por anticipado en el centro de votación anticipada que te corresponde, o en uno de varios si tu comunidad tiene más. Todas las comunidades ofrecen votación anticipada del 24 de octubre al 1 de noviembre. Algunas agregan días, y desde 2026 eso puede incluir el lunes 2 de noviembre, así que revisa tu centro. Metes tu boleta directamente en la máquina de conteo, igual que el Día de las Elecciones. El Día de las Elecciones, ve al lugar de votación que te corresponde entre las 7 a. m. y las 8 p. m.
in_person.quote: Voters may only cast a ballot at their assigned early voting site(s). ... communities may decide to provide additional days of early voting for those elections ... Beginning in 2026, communities may provide early voting on the Monday before Election Day.
in_person.en_after: Early voting is over. On Election Day, go to your assigned polling place between 7 a.m. and 8 p.m. local time.
in_person.es_after: La votación anticipada terminó. El Día de las Elecciones, ve al lugar de votación que te corresponde entre las 7 a. m. y las 8 p. m., hora local.
in_person.notes: Detroit example (City Clerk's Fall 2026 Election Connection newsletter, detroitmi.gov/sites/detroitmi.localhost/files/2026-10/Election%20Connection%20Newsletter_Fall%202026.pdf): 'On Monday, November 2, early voting continues only at the Detroit Department of Elections and the City Clerk's Office in the Coleman A. Young Municipal Center. The hours are from 8 a.m. to 4 p.m.' Not on the page because the fact has one source.

first_time.en: New to Michigan, or moved? Go to your city or township clerk's office with proof of residency, like a utility bill or bank statement, to register. You can vote an absentee ballot right there, or head to your polling place if there's time. If you're in line at the clerk's office by 8 p.m. on Election Day, you can still register and vote.
first_time.es: ¿Eres nuevo en Michigan o te mudaste? Ve a la oficina del secretario de tu ciudad o municipio (clerk) con un comprobante de domicilio, como un recibo de servicios o un estado de cuenta bancario, para registrarte. Ahí mismo puedes votar con una boleta de voto en ausencia, o ir a tu lugar de votación si te da tiempo. Si estás en la fila de la oficina del secretario a las 8 p. m. del Día de las Elecciones, todavía puedes registrarte y votar.
first_time.quote: To vote, they may either request an absentee ballot and vote at their clerk's office or go to their polling place to vote if time allows. So long as an eligible, unregistered resident is in line at their clerk's office by 8 p.m., they may register to vote and cast an absentee ballot.

rule.en: Look up your assigned early voting site and your Election Day polling place at Michigan.gov/Vote. You can only vote early at a site you're assigned to.
rule.es: Busca tu centro de votación anticipada asignado y tu lugar de votación del Día de las Elecciones en Michigan.gov/Vote. Solo puedes votar por anticipado en un centro que te hayan asignado.
rule.quote: They can look up their assigned early voting site(s) up to 60 days prior to Election Day at Michigan.gov/Vote .

en: Driver's license or state ID from Michigan or another state
Federal, state, county or local government photo ID
es: Licencia de conducir o identificación estatal de Michigan o de otro estado
Identificación con foto del gobierno federal, estatal, del condado o local
Licencia para portar pistola oculta (concealed pistol license)
accepted.quote: Driver’s license or state ID card issued by Michigan or another state

expired.en: An expired Michigan driver's license or state ID still works. Any other photo ID has to be current. Your ID doesn't need your address on it.
expired.es: Una licencia de conducir o identificación estatal de Michigan vencida sí sirve. Cualquier otra identificación con foto debe estar vigente. Tu identificación no tiene que mostrar tu dirección.
expired.quote: A voter may use an expired Michigan driver's license or state ID as a valid form of photo ID.

without.en: No photo ID, or forgot it? Sign an affidavit saying you don't have one with you, and you vote a regular ballot that's counted with all the others.
without.es: ¿No tienes identificación con foto o se te olvidó? Firma una declaración jurada de que no la traes, y votas con una boleta regular que se cuenta con todas las demás.
without.quote: Once the affidavit is signed, they may cast a ballot, and it will be counted with all other ballots on Election Day.

who.en: Any registered voter can vote absentee, no reason needed. Check the box on your application to join the permanent list and get a ballot for every election.
who.es: Cualquier votante registrado puede votar en ausencia, sin dar una razón. Marca la casilla en tu solicitud para entrar a la lista permanente y recibir una boleta en cada elección.
who.quote: All registered voters in Michigan have the right to vote by mail using an absentee ballot delivered to their home.

witness.en: Sign and date the return envelope in the space provided, using the signature on your driver's license, state ID or voter registration. Made a mistake, like signing in the wrong place? Ask your clerk for a new ballot.
witness.es: Firma y pon la fecha en el sobre de devolución, en el espacio indicado, con la firma de tu licencia de conducir, identificación estatal o registro de votante. ¿Te equivocaste, por ejemplo firmaste en el lugar equivocado? Pídele una boleta nueva al secretario.
witness.quote: Voters must sign and date the return envelope on the provided space.

cure.en: If your signature is missing or doesn't match, your clerk will reach you by phone, email or text, or by mail if they have no other way. Your clerk must get the cure form back, electronically, in person or by mail, by 5 p.m. on Friday, November 6.
cure.es: Si falta tu firma o no coincide, tu secretario (clerk) se comunicará contigo por teléfono, correo electrónico o mensaje de texto, o por correo postal si no tiene otra forma. Tu secretario debe recibir el formulario de corrección, por vía electrónica, en persona o por correo, a más tardar a las 5 p. m. del viernes 6 de noviembre.
cure.quote: The clerk must notify the elector by telephone, email, or text message, if available. In the absence of the elector's telephone number or email address, the clerk must notify the elector by United States mail.
cure.notes: Return methods: MCL 168.766a ('An elector shall be permitted to receive and return a cure form electronically, in person, or by mail'), read Oct 28; the old text said 'online'.

dropbox.en: Use one of your clerk's drop boxes by 8 p.m. on Election Day. You can also put your finished absentee ballot straight into the tabulator at your early voting site. On Election Day you can do the same at your polling place, except in Detroit, where absentee ballots go to a drop box or the clerk's office.
dropbox.es: Usa uno de los buzones de entrega de tu secretario (clerk) a más tardar a las 8 p. m. del Día de las Elecciones. También puedes meter tu boleta de voto en ausencia ya llenada directamente en la máquina de conteo de tu centro de votación anticipada. El Día de las Elecciones puedes hacer lo mismo en tu lugar de votación, menos en Detroit, donde las boletas de voto en ausencia van a un buzón de entrega o a la oficina del secretario.
dropbox.quote: Ballots must be inserted into a drop box by 8 p.m. on Election Day to be counted.
dropbox.notes: Detroit: SOS absentee page, '*Detroit registered voters are unable to tabulate their absentee ballots at Detroit polling places. On Election Day, Detroit absentee ballots may be returned by drop box or to the local clerk's office.'

gear.en: Leave the campaign shirts, hats, pins and stickers at home. Michigan bans election or campaign clothing and accessories inside a polling place or within 100 feet of it. If you show up in a shirt or button with election images or slogans, you'll be asked to cover or remove it.
gear.es: Deja en casa las camisetas, gorras, botones y calcomanías de campaña. Michigan prohíbe la ropa y los accesorios electorales o de campaña dentro de un lugar de votación o a menos de 100 pies. Si llegas con una camiseta o un botón con imágenes o lemas electorales, te pedirán que lo cubras o te lo quites.
gear.quote: If you go to the polls with a shirt or button bearing election-related images or slogans, you will be asked to cover or remove it.

phone.en: You can take a picture of your own ballot in the voting booth. You can't hold your ballot up for a selfie or take other photos in the voting area, and don't share a picture of your voted ballot within 100 feet of the polling place. Take your sticker selfie outside. The state's guidance doesn't address photos of an absentee ballot at home.
phone.es: Puedes tomarle una foto a tu propia boleta en la cabina de votación. No puedes levantar tu boleta para una selfie ni tomar otras fotos en el área de votación, y no compartas una foto de tu boleta votada a menos de 100 pies del lugar de votación. Tómate la selfie con tu sticker afuera. La guía del estado no habla de fotos de una boleta de voto en ausencia en casa.
phone.quote: Voters can take a picture of their own ballot in the voting booth. For the privacy and security of neighboring voters, voters are prohibited from holding their ballot up for a selfie and/or photo. Voters may, however, take selfies outside of the polling location and are encouraged to do so.
phone.notes: Resolves the earlier conflict. The Vote on Election Day page's 'Do not take a photo within the voting area' is the general rule; the booth photo of your own ballot is the exception from the 2019 Crookston v. Johnson settlement. SOS release May 8, 2019 (michigan.gov/sos/resources/news/2019/05/08/michigan-secretary-of-state-settles-ballot-selfie-case): 'voters will be allowed to take a photograph of their own ballot but only while in the voting booth. The agreement doesn't affect other prohibitions on photography in the area where voting is occurring or sharing ballot images within 100 feet from the polling place'. Read with curl Oct 28.

line.en: Polls close at 8 p.m. If you're in line by then, stay put. You'll be allowed to vote. The same goes at closing time on each day of early voting.
line.es: Los lugares de votación cierran a las 8 p. m. Si estás en la fila a esa hora, no te salgas. Te dejarán votar. Lo mismo aplica a la hora de cierre de cada día de votación anticipada.
line.quote: Every qualified elector present and in line at the polls at the hour prescribed for the closing thereof shall be allowed to vote.

tradition.en: Michigan's 2026 I Voted stickers come from a statewide contest run by the Michigan Department of State. More than 2,000 designs came in, the public voted on 30 finalists in each category, and nine designs won. In elementary and middle school, Aryana of Berrien Springs, Aleymi of Romulus and Naia of Detroit won with a "Let me sleep" sticker, a frog and a space bunny. In high school, Lenore of Saginaw, Ahmad of Dearborn Heights and Keirsten of Remus won with a Michigan license plate, a Michigan landscape and the Edmund Fitzgerald. In general entry, Maddie Tallman, Lisa Damesworth and Hilarie Williams won with "No yeah," Superman ice cream and construction barrels. Local election clerks can order the winning stickers for November, so ask yours which ones they hand out.
tradition.es: Los stickers de I Voted 2026 de Michigan salen de un concurso estatal del Departamento de Estado de Michigan (Michigan Department of State). Llegaron más de 2,000 diseños, el público votó entre 30 finalistas de cada categoría y ganaron nueve. En primaria y secundaria, ganaron Aryana de Berrien Springs, Aleymi de Romulus y Naia de Detroit, con un sticker "Let me sleep" (déjame dormir), una rana y un conejo espacial. En preparatoria, ganaron Lenore de Saginaw, Ahmad de Dearborn Heights y Keirsten de Remus, con una placa de Michigan, un paisaje de Michigan y el Edmund Fitzgerald. En la categoría general, ganaron Maddie Tallman, Lisa Damesworth y Hilarie Williams, con "No yeah", el helado Superman y barriles de construcción. Los secretarios locales (clerks) pueden pedir los stickers ganadores para noviembre, así que pregunta al tuyo cuáles reparten.
tradition.quote: From the 2,000+ designs received this year, the CSATF selected 30 in each category to move forward for public voting. ... Entry category: Elementary/middle (K-8), high school (9-12), or general entry (open to all Michiganders). ... Finalists were selected via online voting open to the public. ... Winning stickers will be available for election clerks to order for the November election.
tradition.notes: Reread Oct 28 (curl, browser UA). Winners and designs from the page's 2026 winner cards: image alt text ('Let me sleep', 'Frog', 'Space bunny', 'Michigan license plate', 'Michigan landscape', 'Edmund Fitzgerald', 'No yeah', 'Superman ice cream', 'Construction barrels' I voted sticker) paired with name and town, and image files named for each winner (IVoted_Tallman.png is 'No yeah'). The first group's heading reads only '2026 winners'; the Aug 18 release (michigan.gov/sos/resources/news/2026/08/18/secretary-benson-announces-2026-i-voted-sticker-design-contest-winners) lists those three as Elementary / Middle School and gives 2,095 designs and over 53,000 votes. That release's image captions credit Lisa Damesworth twice and omit Maddie Tallman; its text list and the contest page name all nine. Student surnames (K to 12 groups) removed; general-entry winners keep the full names the page gives.

mail.en: Look in your ballot envelope. In the City of Northville, every absentee ballot comes with voting instructions and an "I Voted" sticker. Other clerks decide for themselves.
mail.es: Revisa el sobre de tu boleta. En la ciudad de Northville, cada boleta de voto en ausencia llega con instrucciones y un sticker de "I Voted". Los demás secretarios municipales deciden por su cuenta.
mail.quote: Your ballot comes with complete voting instructions and an "I Voted" sticker.

provisional.en: A provisional ballot is used when officials need more information to confirm you can vote. You may get one if your name isn't on the list, you're at the wrong polling place, or you're voting for the first time and can't show the required identification. Forgetting your photo ID alone isn't a reason: you sign an affidavit and vote a regular ballot. With a provisional ballot, you have 6 days to bring ID documents to your city or township clerk. It counts if officials confirm you're registered in the right place.
provisional.es: Se usa una boleta provisional cuando los funcionarios necesitan más información para confirmar que puedes votar. Te pueden dar una si tu nombre no está en la lista, si estás en el lugar de votación equivocado o si votas por primera vez y no puedes mostrar la identificación requerida. Olvidar tu identificación con foto no es motivo por sí solo: firmas una declaración jurada y votas con una boleta regular. Con una boleta provisional, tienes 6 días para llevar tus documentos de identificación al secretario de tu ciudad o municipio (clerk). Cuenta si los funcionarios confirman que estás registrado en el lugar correcto.
provisional.quote: A provisional ballot is a ballot requiring additional steps or information to confirm a voter's eligibility to vote before the ballot can be counted. ... They are voting for the first time and are unable to provide a valid form of identification. After casting a provisional ballot, a voter has 6 days to provide appropriate ID documentation to their city or township clerk.

line.en: You can still vote. Everyone qualified and in line at 8 p.m. on Election Day is allowed to vote, and the same goes at closing time during early voting.
line.es: Igual puedes votar. Toda persona con derecho a votar que esté en la fila a las 8 p. m. del Día de las Elecciones puede votar, y lo mismo aplica a la hora de cierre durante la votación anticipada.
line.quote: During each day of the early voting period, eligible voters waiting in line when an early voting site closes have the right to stay in line and cast a ballot.

track.en: Go to mi.gov/myvoterinfo and check the Absentee ballot section for when your ballot was sent and whether your clerk got it back. Sign up at mi.gov/ballotalert for email updates. Ballots handed in at an early voting site or on Election Day don't show up there.
track.es: Entra a mi.gov/myvoterinfo y revisa la sección de boleta de voto en ausencia (Absentee ballot) para ver cuándo se envió tu boleta y si el secretario ya la recibió. Regístrate en mi.gov/ballotalert para recibir avisos por correo electrónico. Las boletas que entregas en un centro de votación anticipada o el Día de las Elecciones no aparecen ahí.
track.quote: check the "Absentee ballot" section to view the date your ballot was sent and whether the clerk has received your completed ballot.

unsigned.en: Your clerk will contact you with a cure form. Your clerk must get it back, electronically, in person or by mail, by 5 p.m. on Friday, November 6, or your ballot stays rejected.
unsigned.es: Tu secretario (clerk) se comunicará contigo con un formulario de corrección. Tu secretario debe recibirlo, por vía electrónica, en persona o por correo, a más tardar a las 5 p. m. del viernes 6 de noviembre, o tu boleta seguirá rechazada.
unsigned.quote: An absent voter ballot return envelope that is not cured by 5 p.m. on the third day following the election remains rejected.

late_mail.en: In the last two weeks, mailing it isn't recommended. It has to reach your clerk by 8 p.m. on Election Day, so use a drop box, your clerk's office or your early voting site instead.
late_mail.es: En las últimas dos semanas no se recomienda enviarla por correo. Debe llegar al secretario a más tardar a las 8 p. m. del Día de las Elecciones, así que mejor usa un buzón de entrega, la oficina del secretario o tu centro de votación anticipada.
late_mail.quote: Return and submit an absentee ballot by mail (not recommended within 14 days of an election)

notes: Read October 21, 2026 on michigan.gov/sos (Vote on Election Day, Register to Vote, Absentee Voting, Early In-Person Voting, Ballot Tracking, I Voted Sticker Contest) and legislature.mi.gov (MCL 168.720 hours and line, 168.720a early voting minimums, 168.766 cure deadline, 168.766a cure notice). The October 19 registration date is 15 days before November 3, per the SOS 15-day rule and the existing FAQ. Cure deadline: 5 p.m. on the third day after the election = Friday, November 6. Mail application deadline: 5 p.m. the Friday before = October 30. CONFLICT on photos: the Election Day page says not to take a photo within the voting area, while the early voting page and the SOS FAQ say voters may photograph their own ballot in the booth, so polls_rules.phone is missing. Detroit absentee voters can't tabulate at Election Day polling places (stated on the absentee page). No county offices list URL used; the clerk lookup is inside the Voter Information Center.

hours.en: Polling places are open 7 a.m. to 8 p.m. local time.
hours.es: Los lugares de votación abren de 7 a. m. a 8 p. m., hora local.
hours.quote: On the day of any election, the polls shall be opened at 7 o'clock in the forenoon, and shall be continuously open until 8 o'clock in the afternoon and no longer.
